summary: Read pile sizes and a time limit H in hours. There is at least 1 pile and at most 10000 piles. Each pile holds between 1 and 1000000000 bananas. H is at least the pile count and at most 1000000000. In one hour the eater selects a single pile and removes up to her speed in bananas from it. A smaller pile is finished, and she eats nothing else during that hour. She must finish every banana before H hours end. Write the smallest integer speed that makes this possible.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
